ms.report:
Summary
We have successfully completed the ability to split an extended Ed25519 key (used for Cardano wallets) into multiple key shares (N sub-keys) and generate a valid signature by combining the signature shares of M keys (where M <= N) using Shamir Secret Sharing.
・The Shamir Secret Sharing algorithm fully implemented.
・The necessary elliptic curve functionality for the algorithm.
・All code is open-sourced and available in our GitLab repository.

Evidence of Completion
・Gitlab issue tracking
・Static site for documentation (see background and API description pages)
・Specific unit tests verifying Shamir Secret Sharing functionality (automatically run as part of CI job)
・Completed CI/CD job
